info.title: Wealth Master API
info.description: Session authentication, MFA, owner-scoped accounts, ledger activity, native-currency net worth and spending by category for a selected calendar month or year. Exact expense/refund/net totals, inclusive category breakdowns and supporting activity; budgeting is deferred. Monthly expected income, expenses and transfers with reviewed suggestions, skips and atomic actual recording. Guided legacy-workbook migration stages private XLSX/XLSM data, requires explicit mappings and approvals, previews duplicates/balances, commits atomically and supports guarded reversal. Manual investment holdings, opening lots, purchases/sales with explicit account-currency cash settlement, reviewed lot allocation and guarded reversals; market valuation is deferred. Holdings-first investment accounts, keyless stock/ETF lookup, timestamped market prices and explicit FX valuation into account currency. Missing/stale market data is visible; fees can be entered separately as spending. ISIN-identified funds with exact dated manual NAV entry, preserved correction history and account/net-worth valuation.

get.summary: Calculate current net worth for the authenticated owner
get.description: One repeatable-read snapshot of opening balances plus all non-deleted ledger movements through the business date, including entries before account opening. Future-dated activity is excluded until its transaction date. Positive balances are assets; negative balances are liabilities. Includes active accounts and investment cash only; archived accounts are excluded from totals, breakdowns, contributions and future-account listings. Active future-opening accounts are listed separately and excluded from totals. Native currencies remain separate; no FX conversion or security valuation. Business date uses APP_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE. Read-only; no CSRF token required.

post.summary: Register using an email-bound, single-use invitation
post.description: Cache-Control: no-store.  Registration defaults to disabled. Codes expire after seven days. Email is normalized; code is case-sensitive. Invalid, expired, revoked, used, mismatched and duplicate-account attempts use a generic rejection. Account creation and consumption are atomic. Five failures per server-resolved client address lock registration attempts for five minutes, independently of login. Signed-in and MFA-pending sessions must sign out first. Successful signup establishes the existing MFA session flow (required in production).

unvaluedHoldings.description: Positive active account/security positions missing a price or required FX quote; excluded from incomplete totals.

name.description: Trimmed; unique case-insensitively within owner/type/parent, including archived categories.
Trimmed; unique case-insensitively within owner/type/parent, including archived categories.

hasActivity.description: Permanent ledger references, including deleted activity and previously selected parents.

expenses.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

refunds.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

netSpending.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

uncategorized.description: Exact uncategorized net spending in this currency.

defaultCurrency.description: Explicitly selected ISO 4217 currency. Null until selected.
Supported ISO 4217 code; no inferred default.

ExpectedInput.description: Monthly only. Months use their first calendar day; lastMonth is inclusive. Dates use years 1–9999. Amount must be positive. Currency follows account. Transfers require distinct same-currency accounts and no category. Edits update historical months too.

ExpectedOccurrence.description: Version 0 denotes untouched reconciliation state. Differences are actual minus expected; null when no actual or currencies differ. Deleted, incompatible or out-of-schedule links need review. Future-dated confirmed links show SCHEDULED until their transaction date; these amounts remain outstanding and are excluded from completed/actual totals.

ExpectedTotals.description: Exact decimal strings. Skipped items excluded. Completed is expected amounts for compatible confirmed links; actual is their ledger amounts. Transfers remain separate.

ExpectedReconcile.description: Full replacement: null operationId unlinks, skipped true skips this month. Linking requires current operationVersion and matching type, currency and accounts; actual dates may be in any month. One transaction can satisfy one occurrence.

ExpectedRecordInput.description: Reviewed actual fields; accounts/type come from definition. Creates ledger activity and confirms association atomically. Date may be in any month, including before account opening, and must use years 1–9999. The occurrence stays in its selected month; spending uses the actual transaction date. Future months and dates are allowed; future links are scheduled until their date.

code.description: Secret code returned once, never available on reads.

workbook.description: Parsed sheet/row/cell values, formulas and cached results; null after source purge.

columns.description: Distinct A–ZZZ column references for date, kind, account, description, amount, balance, category, card and cardText.

ImportPlan.description: Versioned account/card/category targets, row decisions and duplicate choices. Creation inputs remain proposals until commit.

token.description: SHA-256 token binding approval to this exact plan and preview context.

amount.description: Exact positive decimal amount; no FX conversion.

InvestmentSecurityInput.description: STOCK/ETF listings or manually entered FUND. FUND requires a check-digit-validated ISIN, unique per owner, and explicit currency; symbol/exchange are canonically stored as ISIN/NAV.

InvestmentSecurity.description: STOCK/ETF listings or manually entered FUND. FUND requires a check-digit-validated ISIN, unique per owner, and explicit currency; symbol/exchange are canonically stored as ISIN/NAV.

quantity.description: Exact decimal string. Quantity and execution price must be positive for trades.
Exact decimal string. Quantity and execution price must be positive for trades.

InvestmentInput.description: OPENING creates shares without cash, permitting unknown acquisition date/cost. BUY/SELL require positive execution price, actual inclusive settlement and cashDate. CHF settlement can accompany USD execution; no FX is inferred. Allocations omitted means reviewed FIFO; explicit allocations must exactly equal sold quantity. New UI trade cash excludes fees/taxes separately recorded as spending; original inclusive-settlement records remain supported for correction.

quantity.description: Exact decimal string. Quantity and execution price must be positive for trades.

HoldingValuation.description: Funds use source MANUAL_NAV, a date-only navDate and null quotedAt. navHistory contains the newest correction per valuation date for the latest thirty distinct dates, in ascending date order. PreviousClose/changePercent mean the preceding distinct dated NAV and its change for funds. Source reference is user-entered. Stocks/ETFs retain automatic quote/series behavior.

InvestmentValuation.description: Ledger cash plus exact quantity × latest security quote × explicit FX in account currency; each holding rounded HALF_UP to eight decimals. Missing price/FX excluded and counted, never valued at cost. Source/quote/fetch timestamps retained. Older means fetched over one day ago or quoted over seven days ago. Daily change compares latest quote to previous daily close; series is price history, not performance. Funds use the latest applicable manual NAV date, then latest correction on that date. A manual NAV older than seven calendar days relative to the app business date is marked older; entry time never substitutes for valuation date.

nav.description: Strictly positive exact NAV per unit; no rounding of entered values.

ManualNavInput.description: Published NAV business date on or before today; explicit active owned investment account with a retained reference to the owned fund. Currency follows the fund. Same-date entries are preserved corrections; older dates do not displace newer valuation dates. Identical owner/security/requestId/input retries return the original receipt.
